name: The Doors

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles four-piece formed in 1965. No bassist onstage—Ray Manzarek covered bass on keyboards. The Doors (1967) put organ-led blues-psych and Jim Morrison’s baritone on AM and FM radio.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶四人组，1965 年成立。台上无贝斯手——Ray Manzarek 用键盘补贝斯。同名首专（1967）把风琴主导的蓝调迷幻与 Jim Morrison 男中音送上 AM/FM。

essentialTracks.title: Break On Through (To the Other Side)

note.en: Krieger composition. Organ and flamenco-leaning guitar solos on the LP; shorter AM radio edit.
note.zh: Krieger 作曲。LP 上有风琴与偏弗拉门戈吉他独奏；AM 电台剪辑更短。

scenes.track: Break On Through (To the Other Side)

note.en: Opener on the 1967 debut. Jazz-leaning drums under Morrison’s baritone.
note.zh: 1967 首专开场曲。偏爵士鼓点衬 Morrison 男中音。

note.en: From L.A. Woman. Fender Rhodes and rain sound effects; late-period blues.
note.zh: 出自 L.A. Woman。Fender Rhodes 与雨声效果；晚期蓝调。

interviewQuotes.text: Expose yourself to your deepest fear; after that, fear has no power.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jim Morrison

interviewQuotes.text: No bass player. Ray’s left hand was the bass.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Robby Krieger

lyricQuotes: You know that it would be untrue / You know that I would be a liar

shortBio.en: Morrison–Manzarek organ blues-psych, Los Angeles, 1965–71. Light My Fire is the main hit; no bassist onstage.
shortBio.zh: Morrison–Manzarek 风琴蓝调迷幻，洛杉矶，1965–71。主要热单为 Light My Fire；台上无贝斯手。

body.en:
The Doors formed in Los Angeles in 1965. Jim Morrison sang; Ray Manzarek played keyboards and covered bass with his left hand and pedals; Robby Krieger played guitar; John Densmore played drums.

The debut album The Doors (1967) included Break On Through and Light My Fire. Later albums include Strange Days, Waiting for the Sun, and L.A. Woman (1971). Morrison died in Paris in July 1971. The remaining three recorded briefly without him, then stopped.
body.zh:
The Doors 于 1965 年在洛杉矶成立。Jim Morrison 主唱；Ray Manzarek 弹键盘，并以左手与踏板补贝斯；Robby Krieger 弹吉他；John Densmore 打鼓。

首专 The Doors（1967）收录 Break On Through 与 Light My Fire。后续专辑包括 Strange Days、Waiting for the Sun 与 L.A. Woman（1971）。Morrison 于 1971 年 7 月在巴黎去世。其余三人短暂继续录音后停止。

title.zh: 风琴贝斯与男中音前站

body.en:
The band had no bassist onstage. Manzarek used Fender Rhodes bass pedals and Vox Continental (or similar) for the low end. Krieger wrote several of the hits. Morrison sang in a baritone range and used spoken passages.

The sound stayed blues-rooted within Los Angeles psychedelic rock, with room for organ and guitar solos.
body.zh:
台上无贝斯手。Manzarek 用 Fender Rhodes 贝斯踏板与 Vox Continental（或同类）补低频。Krieger 写过多首热单。Morrison 以男中音演唱，并使用说白段落。

声音仍扎根蓝调，属于洛杉矶迷幻摇滚，编曲给风琴与吉他独奏留空。

title.zh: 经典四人至 Morrison 去世

body.en:
The studio and live peak lineup was Morrison, Manzarek, Krieger, and Densmore from 1965 to 1971.

Albums after Morrison’s death, recorded by the remaining three, are a short footnote. The main catalog ends with L.A. Woman.
body.zh:
1965–71 的录音与现场巅峰阵容为 Morrison、Manzarek、Krieger、Densmore。

Morrison 去世后由其余三人录制的专辑是短暂脚注。主要目录止于 L.A. Woman。

body.en:
Morrison handled vocals and much of the lyric writing. Manzarek split keyboard parts between bass lines and organ leads. Krieger used fingerstyle and slide; Densmore brought jazz and Latin accents on the kit.

Arrangements often left space for extended organ or guitar solos, as on the album cut of Light My Fire.
body.zh:
Morrison 负责人声与大量歌词。Manzarek 在贝斯线与风琴主奏之间分工。Krieger 使用指弹与滑音；Densmore 在鼓组上带爵士与拉丁点缀。

编曲常给延长的风琴或吉他独奏留空，如 Light My Fire 专辑版。

body.en:
Written by Robby Krieger. The LP version includes long organ and guitar solos; the AM radio edit cuts the middle section.

It was a 1967 crossover hit and the band’s widest early exposure on US radio.
body.zh:
Robby Krieger 作曲。LP 版含长风琴与吉他独奏；AM 电台剪辑砍掉中段。

1967 年跨界热单，是乐队早期在美国电台最广的曝光。

body.en:
From the L.A. Woman sessions (1971). Electric piano, rain sound effects, and a quieter vocal delivery than the early carnival-leaning hits.

One of the last major studio tracks before Morrison’s death.
body.zh:
出自 L.A. Woman 录音（1971）。电钢琴、雨声效果，人声比早期偏热闹的热单更安静。

Morrison 去世前最后的重要录音室曲目之一。

body.en:
Post-punk and goth acts have drawn on Morrison’s baritone delivery and spoken breaks. The keyboard-as-bass live setup remains uncommon in rock.

The active peak was short (1967–71); the radio catalog stayed in rotation afterward.
body.zh:
后朋克与哥特乐队常借鉴 Morrison 的男中音与说白。现场以键盘当贝斯的编制在摇滚中仍不常见。

活跃巅峰较短（1967–71）；之后电台曲目仍长期轮播。

note.en: Morrison-era studio and live lineup through L.A. Woman.
note.zh: Morrison 时期录音与现场阵容，至 L.A. Woman。

note.en: Organ and guitar solo hit that put the band on AM radio.
note.zh: 风琴与吉他独奏热单，把乐队送上 AM 电台。

note.en: Bass-less organ setup plus baritone blues-psych song forms.
note.zh: 无贝斯风琴编制 + 男中音蓝调迷幻曲式。
